remarks: Charming Brick Cape Cod in the Heart of the Village of Williamsville. This 4 bedroom, 2-full-bath home offers a wonderful blend of classic charm, comfortable living, and versatile spaces. The welcoming first floor features a spacious family room, formal dining room, and well-appointed kitchen with newer stainless steel appliances, along with two generously sized bedrooms and a full bath. Upstairs, you’ll find two additional bedrooms, a second full bath, and an inviting open loft area perfect for a home office, reading nook, or additional living space. An unfinished bonus area offers even more possibilities for future expansion or customization. Outside, enjoy a private backyard retreat featuring a deck, dedicated gardening area, and an oversized 2+ car detached garage complete with its own bar area—ideal for entertaining, hobbies, or extra storage. Partially finished basement with egress. Whole house generator for peace of mind. Full of charm, character, and potential, this delightful home offers a rare opportunity to enjoy Village living with convenient walking access to local shops, restaurants, parks, and all that Williamsville has to offer! Open Houses Saturday 10/17/26 11-1PM  & Sunday 10/17/26 11-1PM. Offers due Tuesday 10/20 at 9AM.
